decision.reason: Memory_clock has the best trajectory-level validation error, but residual autocorrelation remains and clock effects are not independently established. PRBS provides varied input histories to test predictive differences.
decision.prediction: At matched elapsed times, memory_clock and history_all predictions will diverge most during irregular input changes; persistent forecast errors would challenge the current model.

mapping.target_relation: No independent elapsed-time driver is yet supported; clock features improve prediction but may proxy for unmodeled input-history dynamics.
mapping.condition_to_check: Compare predictions and outputs across interventions aligned by elapsed time; absent shared clock-linked variation weakens this relation.
